title: Continuity is the primitive physical law

statements.text: Covariant continuity is the one law beneath all others: a physical distinction must stay lawfully related to itself through change, or no physical history joins its states. Conservation, admissibility, recoverability and persistence are its descendants.
statements.scope: the Descendancy of Physical Law series, July 2026

sources.quote: I began beneath the branches and asked what must remain true before any physical distinction can persist through change. The answer is continuity.
Continuity is the law which carries that identity.
